items.caption:
9 of the best tips that will help you keep your food veggies fresher for longer 🥬🍅 Save this post for your next grocery shop to help avoid wastage and keep your food fresh. Which tip will you try first? Let me know what you’d like to see in part 2 🌻 

1. Berries: Store berries in a container lined with paper towel. It absorbs excess moisture, which helps slow mould growth
2. Lettuce: Wrap lettuce in paper towel. Lettuce wilts because of moisture, so the paper towel keeps it crisp
3. Herbs: Store herbs in a bouquet of water to keep them hydrated and prevent them drying out
4 / 5: Avocados: Store unripe avocados at room temperature and ripe avocados in the fridge
6. Potatoes: Store an apple with your potatoes to prevent spouting
7. Carrots: Submerge carrots in water to keep them crunchy. This is a great one for quick lunchbox prep!
8. Tomatoes: Store tomatoes upside down at room temperature to prevent them ripening
9. Bananas: Wrap banana stems in foil to slow down ripening of your entire fruit bowl

Which one of your favourite? Hope these quick tips were helpful lovelies xx 

#fridgerestock #fridgeorganization #tipsandtricks #mamamilastips #homehacks

Lettuce wilts because of moisture, so the paper towel helps keep it crisp. Store herbs in a bouquet of water to keep them hydrated and prevent them drying out. Store unripe avocados at room temperature and ripe avocados in the fridge. And this one's my favourite. Store an apple with your potatoes to prevent spouting. Submerge carrots in water to keep them crunchy. And store tomatoes upside down at room temperature. And wrap the stems of your bananas in foil to slow down ripening.
